blurb: Nordegg Historic Golf Course offers a 9-hole golf experience with views on every hole and unique challenges suitable for beginners, kids, and experienced golfers. The course provides cart and club rentals, hosts tournaments, and has a clubhouse with snacks and beverages including a BBQ burger menu. Memberships and green fees are reasonably priced, and special event nights are held weekly.
